blocks.content: Here's a step-by-step breakdown of the function calls and return values.
The print_numbers() function calls itself until n equals 4.
When n equals 4, the base case is reached.
When the base case is reached, the last function returns None.
All other functions also return None because there are no further statements to execute after their respective recursive calls.
It is important to be cautious and not assume that all recursive functions return None solely because of the base case.
This concept will be essential as we delve into more complex problems.
